thread:
ash (eng-runtime): hey folks, Ash here — joined eng-runtime today. quick setup question: who is the owner for service account keys and API key rotation for demo infra? need read/write to models-bucket and a token to call hosted metrics for a customer-facing demo on Friday.
jamie (People Ops): welcome @ash :wave: typically security owns key rotation policy and infra owns the SA provisioning. fill out the access request form on the hub and mark it urgent for demo. I can help route it.
leo (security): hi @ash — security reviews rotation & vault policies. for short-term demos we can issue an expiring Vault token tied to a service account, but long-term you should use the managed SA with rotation. DM me the demo scope and expiry required.
maya (platform): platform grants the deploy/run roles. if you need s3 access we do the ACL + role-binding once infra creates the SA. DM me your GitHub handle and the stack name and Ill pre-stage the role.
nash (ash): thanks — demo needs access until 2026-04-08, GH handle ash_codes, stack: runtime-demo. can someone post the minimal ticket body I should paste into #help?
leo (security): paste this into #help and tag @leo @infra-oncall:
```
Subject: access-request: ash (runtime-demo)
- Github: ash_codes
- Resources: s3://redwood-models (read/write), hosted.metrics:read
- Service account: request creation for runtime-demo-sa
- Intended expiry: 2026-04-08
- Purpose: customer demo Fri 2026-04-03
- Manager: Priya (eng-runtime)
```
infra-bot: new request queued (id: req-1746020002). ETA 24h, flagged as demo-priority.
nash (ash): filing now, tagging @maya @leo. any special escalation if infra is blocked?
jamie (People Ops): if it blocks a customer-facing demo, page infra P1 on PagerDuty and cc me and your manager. also open a follow-up thread in #release-war-room if deployment timeline slips.
leo (security): also note: for any token issued we require a ticket with purpose + expiry. if you need rotations automated later, open an RFC with security and platform.
maya (platform): once infra confirms SA created Ill bind the role and post the deploy key here. I can also create a short-lived demo token (expires EOD on demo day) if you want fast access.
nash (ash): awesome — filing and paging now. appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
